text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Haha, hahahaha! I am the 'ruler of beauty'. You should prostrate yourself before my beauty again tonight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
はーっはっは！
ボクこそは『美を統べる者』。
今宵もボクの美しさにひれ伏すといいよ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: ...What are you saying all of a sudden?
text_block_list.orig_text: ……お主はいきなりなにを言っておるのじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Geez, you’re so unenthusiastic. I tried to match Illya.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
ノリが悪いなぁ。
イリヤに合わせてあげたのに。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Were you playing along with me just now?! ...You don't seem nervous when we're about to have a fight. Are you scared of anything?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のわらわに合わせておったのか！？
……これから一戦交えようというときになんと緊張感のない。
お主に怖いものはないのか？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: I do, of course I do!

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: It's your own beauty, isn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text: 自分自身の美しさじゃろ？
